main_text.p: in lucem proferam, ad Ephef.3.9. Aphel אַנְהַר, Lucere, Illucere, Illuminare, accendere, illustrare, colustrare. Ithpeh. אִתְנְהַר Illuminari, Illustrari. Syr. ܢܗܪܐ Ut illustremur, 2.ad Corinth.4.6.
ܢܗܝܪܐ Syr. Splendidus, lucidus, lucidum: Item substantive Lux, lumen, Act.26.18. 2.Cor.6.14.
Plur. ܢܗܝܪܝܢ Pater luminum, Jac.1.17. Fœm. ܢܗܝܪܬܐ Lucida, Matth.17.5.
נְהוֹרָא, נְהוֹר Ch.Lux, lumen, luminare, splendor. Plur. נְהוֹרָיָא, נְהוֹרִין.
נְהוֹרָא, נְהָרָא Ch.&Syr. Idem. Plur. ܢܗܘܪܝܢ Festum luminum, id est, Epiphaniæ.
נְהִירוּ Ch. Idem, Dan.5.11. per Apocopam pro נְהִירוּת.
אֲנְהָרוּתָא, אֲנְהָרוּת Ch. Illuminatio, accensio lucis, lux, luminare.
אֲנְהוֹרִי Ch.Idē. Exo.35.14. per apocopam, pro אֲנְהוֹרִית.
נְהָרָה, נְהָרָא, נְהַר Ch.&Syr. Flumen, fluvius, rivus. Plural. נְהָרִי, נְהָרִין.
נְהָרוּתָא Ch.Idem, Esth.1.3. in Targ.sec.sub finem. Plur. Ch.&Syr. נְהָרִין, נְהָרוּתָא Flumina.
נוב Hebr. Provenire, progerminare, Fructum proferre seu producere. Hinc
נוב Ch. Proventus, Germen, Fructus, Hos.8.7.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are reproduced from the scan as best as legible; the Syriac and some pointed Hebrew forms are uncertain and may differ in detail. The printed text is set partly in small type with dotted vowel marks.
